description: Returns what reviewers say about one provider or pharmacy: rating by source, how the rating moved over 30, 60 and 90 days, review topics (customer support, shipping, product quality, switching) with the share of positive reviews, a summary, quotes from both sides, and Reddit quotes with links. The topic input returns one of those topics in more detail. A brand with reviews and no listed prices includes suggested providers that do list prices. A provider with prices includes links.getStarted.

name.description: Provider or pharmacy whose reviews to read: name, slug or id.

state.description: The person’s US state, as a two-letter code or a full name. Prices and links in the result are for this state.

topic.description: One review topic to return in more detail, such as "shipping", "communication" (customer support), "product quality", "switching", or another topic listed in the result.

type.description: Whether the name is a telehealth provider, a compounding pharmacy, or "any" for both.

name: get_glp1_reviews
title: Read what reviewers say
